newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedbank/SILF Oct purchasing managers index 52.3.
newsitem.headline: Swedbank/SILF Oct purchasing managers index 52.3.

text.p: Swedish commercial bank Swedbank and logistics institute SILF said on Friday that their purchasing managers' index for October had fallen to 52.3 from 55.3 in September and 54.3 in August.
The institutes said that although the index had fallen in October, the index value for October was nonetheless in the so-called "growth zone".
"For this reason, there is at present no reason to fear a turnaround in the wrong direction," Swedbank and SILF said in a statement.
Even so, the development in the index over the summer had indicated a relatively modest improvement in the business cycle.
"Further analytical observation will be required, particularly as regards order intake, whose sub-index fell to 52.5 in October," the institutes said.
The purchasing managers' index, which is regarded as a good early indicator of swings in the industrial cycle, quantifies order intake, production, capacity utilisation, delivery times and stocks.
Most of the sub-indices were almost unchanged from September, with the exception of order intake, which fell to 52.5 from 58.6, and production, which fell to 55.6 from 60.9.
